name: Strait of Gibraltar and the Mediterranean
description: First location outside California: the Messinian Salinity Crisis (about 5.97-5.33 Ma) and the Zanclean flood through the Strait of Gibraltar (about 5.33 Ma). Frames are for the viewer, not geological boundaries.
crs: EPSG:4326 (grid cells equally spaced in longitude and latitude)
zoom_note: Terrain Tiles zoom picked so that tile pixels are finer than the output cells.
